draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.48, the 9th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 2nd of 30 at DT. He went 5th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Christian Wilkins. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 4 sacks in 2024, 11th of 30 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns. 17 career games and 17 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (8 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 72.3% (95th percentile), approximate value 8 (89th percentile), tackles for loss 7 (88th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 interior lineman who played: 7 pressures against a median of 2, above the norm.
